hook.text: That tweet from 2015. That party photo. 70% of employers now check social media before hiring.

buildup.text: Your digital footprint includes everything searchable: posts, comments, tagged photos, forum replies.

discovery.text: Google yourself regularly. Set alerts for your name. Know what others find.

twist.text: Deletion isn't always possible. The better strategy is flooding results with professional content.

climax.text: Create enough positive, professional content that old noise gets pushed to page two of Google.

punchline.text: You can't erase the past. You can outrank it.

quiz.question: What's the most effective way to manage negative digital footprints?
options: Create positive professional content to outrank it

details.summary: Your digital footprint includes everything searchable about you online, from social media posts to comments, forum contributions, and tagged photos. Managing it means auditing, curating, and strategically shaping what the internet says about you.
details.whyItMatters: Eighty percent of recruiters search candidates online before interviews. An unmanaged digital footprint can eliminate you from consideration before you even know you were being evaluated.
takeaways: Google yourself regularly to see what others find first
Remove or untag content inconsistent with your professional brand
Create positive content that pushes unwanted results lower in search

faq.question: How do you remove negative content about yourself from the internet?
faq.answer: Contact the website directly to request removal. For search results, use Google's removal request tools for outdated or harmful content. If removal is impossible, create high-quality positive content that outranks the negative result over time.

faq.question: Should you keep personal and professional social media accounts separate?
faq.answer: It depends on your field and comfort level. Keeping them separate reduces risk of professional damage from personal content. However, showing appropriate personal depth on professional platforms can humanize your brand and build deeper connections.
